title: centella triflora
intro: Centella triflora, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a type of herbaceous plant that belongs to the family Apiaceae. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and aiding in the treatment of various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Centella triflora include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including triterpenoids, saponins, and flavonoids. These bioactive compounds are thought to contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic uses in the treatment of various diseases, including neurodegenerative disorders and cardiovascular diseases.
